events.text: loaded-1t: Chris (3): with every other core spinning, one thread loses 24% from clock alone; the 48-thread profile showed each thread 31% slower, so about three quarters of the per-thread drop at one thread per core is frequency, not our code. Rust drops by the same proportion. Why: spin on 16 cores -14%, on 47 cores -24%; a spinning SMT sibling costs 30% and everything busy 49%.
